agent_explanation: Controller-driven hover body (ignores gravity) is pushed left at ~9.3 m/s with sustained fmax=42.95 N into a thin wall (w=0.346). Collision positional correction/impulse is insufficient to repel the controller force, so the body gradually sinks through the wall side/top corner: distance_to_surface goes from -0.062 at step 350 to -0.100 at 351 to -0.138 at 352 to -0.175 at 353, exceeding 0.15 limit. With only 2 substeps per step (dt~0.004), per-substep displacement ~0.019 m allows progressive interpenetration rather than a single tunneling event, indicating force-biased integration outruns contact resolution.
